name: Candy AI
summary: Multimedia companion product: text, generated images/video, and voice in one app. Free browsing previews exist, but paid media runs through a monthly token allowance.
ranking_rationale: First-party subscription and product pages verify $13.99 recurring monthly (with a $9.99 intro month), the $47.88 annual offer, voice interaction, and adult-generation features. Free tier is a 7-day trial per marketing, not a permanent allowance — weaker testability than its rivals, so it ranks as a multimedia pick, not a free-first pick.

pricing.free_tier: Browsing/previews + advertised 7-day trial; no permanent message allowance verified

plans.name: Premium (monthly)
plans.notes: Recurring rate; first month advertised at $9.99. Unlimited text + 100 monthly tokens for media.

plans.name: Premium (annual)
plans.notes: $3.99/month effective; billed upfront; page says renews at the same price and term.

pricing.notes: Tokens are spent on images, voice, and video — unlimited text does not mean unlimited media. Local taxes may apply.

pros: Text, media, and voice combined in one product
Annual offer cuts the effective monthly rate sharply
cons: Free tier is a trial/preview, not an indefinite allowance
100 monthly media tokens go fast on images/video
Discounted first month rises at monthly renewal
Tokens billed on top of the subscription - media costs keep coming after payment
Community-reported: awkward cancellation and chargeback-threat policy
